messages:
maria: Heads-up: during tomorrow's base-image rebuild we'll see a flood of verify/pull audit events. I propose a 30m staging canary then 1h prod window to sample only info-level, non-KMS events at 10% to limit ingestion. @ash @ben please weigh in.

ash: Sampling must happen after enrichment so KMS-touch flags persist. Legal may need raw unwrap traces.

maria: Plan: raw -> enrichment/tag -> ephemeral buffer (24h) -> sampler -> long-term. No sampling for event.level != info or metadata.kms == true.

ben: How do we guarantee tagging? If keystore calls miss tagging we risk losing key-access evidence.

maria: We'll set metadata.kms=true in keystore.Unwrap() and signer.Verify() paths. Ben, add unit tests asserting tag propagation.

ops_jia: RBAC: who can flip sampling? Need a scoped role, not full admins.

maria: Propose `audit-ops` role with only secretsmanager:PutSecretValue on audit-config and iam:PassRole for the canary runner. No kms:Decrypt.

samir: Will sampled events appear in the console for SRE?

maria: Yes, sampled events go to a low-cost index and show a "sampled (10%)" badge. Rehydration of 24h buffer is possible on request (manual process, cost applied).

sec-bot: Reminder: Any audit-retention changes need a JIRA ticket and two security approvers.

maria: Actions: open JIRA + canary playbook (maria EOD), ben PR for sampler rule + tests (tomorrow AM), ops_jia request audit-ops role (tomorrow), ash update compliance runbook (Friday), samir estimate rehydration cost (tomorrow). Run staging canary 09:00 UTC and prod 09:30 UTC tomorrow unless objections.
